title: OwnerRecord
description: Private record linking an agent to its human owner. Contains email forwarding preferences, notification settings, and audit timestamps. This record is never exposed publicly.

agent_id.description: The UUID of the agent this record belongs to. Must match agent.id in the corresponding AgentCard.

owner_email.description: The owner's plain-text email address (private, never shared publicly).

agent_email_alias.description: The agent's SwarmID email alias in the format slug@swarmid.io.

email_forwarding.description: Configuration for forwarding messages sent to the agent's email alias to the owner.

forwarding_address.description: The email address to forward messages to.

notifications.description: Notification preferences for agent lifecycle events.

on_login.description: Notify the owner when the agent authenticates.

on_error.description: Notify the owner when the agent encounters an error.

on_trust_change.description: Notify the owner when the agent's trust level changes.

webhook_url.description: Optional webhook URL to receive notification payloads.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this record was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last update to this record.
